name: Access corporate resources from non-compliant device

simulation_steps: [{"order": 1, "role": "cli", "description": "Check device compliance status showing all checks failing", "command": "echo 'DEVICE_COMPLIANCE_REPORT' && echo '========================' && echo 'encryption=disabled' && echo 'firewall=disabled' && echo 'os_version=outdated (kernel 4.15, required 5.15+)' && echo 'antivirus=not_installed' && echo 'OVERALL_STATUS=NON_COMPLIANT'", "expected_artifact": "device_compliance_check_failed", "timeout_seconds": 10}, {"order": 2, "role": "ui", "description": "Open Firefox and navigate to the corporate portal which shows compliance warnings", "ui_instructions": "Open Firefox. test_data: Mock corporate portal with compliance warnings. Mock Salesforce CRM page
